basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, diving into the world of Google Pixel devices with my Pixel 4. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore technology and digital art. In my free time, I enjoy attending live music events and experimenting with photography, particularly urban and nature shots. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after work. Despite being new to Reddit, I'm eager to learn and contribute to communities that align with my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily revolves around graphic design and photography. I have a degree in Visual Arts, and I constantly update my skills through online courses and tutorials. Recently, I've been exploring mobile photography techniques, especially using the Google Pixel camera.
